title: Married couples, by element
caption:
Every marriage has two elements. Here's what happens when they meet.

Fire plans the anniversary trip; Water remembers the small things. Air says yes to every invitation; Earth checks the calendar and saves them both. Traditionally, the strongest pairs aren't twins: they balance each other.

Tag your parents or your married friends. Which pair are they?
